title: Transferable signals derive their feminine forms; the gender scan reads them
deviations_from_card: Critic revision applied: the derivation is ADDITIVE (with_feminine_forms appends feminine_probe_forms full words; the authored stems pedagoz/pravnic/vojack and poradkyn stay). Case 6 restated: stems stay in _AUTHORED_TRANSFERABLE_MAP and _TRANSFERABLE_MAP, the full forms pedagozka/pravnice/pravnicka/vojacka are added beside them, poradce derives nothing. Added case 8 (guard): 'Praxe pedagozky'/'Prace pravnicky'/'Sluzba vojacky' earn the same skills and domain grade as their masculine twins. ('Pravnik','Pravnice') added to GENDERED_TITLES. The scan is a separate function scan_transferable_gender_gaps(groups=None, derive=True) rather than a third branch inside scan_gender_gaps, so existing synthetic-taxonomy tests (derive=False == []) keep their meaning; main() sums both and the GENDER PARITY line names all three consumers. Tests landed in the same commits as the code they pin (each commit green) rather than a separate red test commit.
notes: Cases red before: 1 (Pravnice), 3 (authored scan), 4 (planted scan), 5 (English no-op / additive shape), 6 (additive stems + full forms), 7 (CLI counts transferable). Green before by design: 2 (pravnickych osob negative control) and 8 (inflected guard). tsc: my change is Python-only; `npm run typecheck` exit 2 was entirely on foreign in-flight paths (kpi-sim/** untracked, app/_components/voice/*, app/features/library/jobs/JobsRediscovery*, app/_lib/journey/project.ts); schemas:gen only rewrote line endings of contract-constants.generated.ts / schemas.generated.ts, restored. test:unit 10812 pass / 2 BROKEN, both foreign in-flight: app/_lib/task-failure-code.test.ts (catalog/refusal registry) and app/features/hiring/pipeline/drawerCommsTruth.test.ts (comms-dispatch literals) - I touched no TS. test:perf red only on app/api/agents/hire-from-need/route.ts 3185 KB vs 3183 ceiling - a TS import graph, no Python in it, not mine.
